name: cicd-lab
description: A tiny zero-dependency static site (the Magic Button) with a real CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions: lint -> test matrix -> build -> deploy -> post-deploy smoke test.

scripts.start: node -e "const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=q.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const fp=p.join('dist',u);f.readFile(fp,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404,{'Content-Type':'text/plain'});s.end('404 - run npm run build first');return;}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':fp.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':fp.endsWith('.js')?'text/javascript':'text/html'});s.end(d);});}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('Preview the BUILT site at http://localhost:8080 (Ctrl+C to stop)'))"
